data.name: Akolyta
data.detailed_description:
They say the truth shall set you free… but what if your truth is the only thing keeping you from uncovering the dark?

Akolyta is a story-driven, first-person psychological horror adventure set in the decaying industrial city of Gorenwille — a place where faith, science, and human desperation collide.

You play as Marshall Gregory Prime, a detective pulled back into a world he tried to escape when a string of ritualistic murders begins to mirror the case that once destroyed his life. The deeper you investigate, the clearer it becomes: the killings are not isolated. They are the work of a growing cult — and the rot runs all the way back to the darkest secrets of the Cold War.

As you close in on the truth, you'll face the worst products of the MK Ultra program and a far more intimate enemy: your own deteriorating mind. Health does not regenerate. Ammunition is scarce. Some places will offer you no weapon at all — only your wits, your flashlight, and the courage to keep walking into the dark.

Akolyta is built around an honest, unflinching representation of mental health, and it is being crafted episodically by the indie team at Pterosoft Studio.

INVESTIGATE

  • Case Board — Collect physical evidence and witness testimony, then map them onto your Case Board. Connect disparate clues to trigger Deductions: logical breakthroughs that unlock dialogue, pinpoint suspects, and earn arrest warrants.

  • Breadcrumbs — Police ledgers, discarded correspondence, witness statements, and dictation recordings. Subtle inflection and background noise corroborate timelines. Miss one note and a critical gap opens in your deduction.

  • Multiple Conclusions — Investigations rarely point to a single answer. How you read the evidence shapes what you believe — and what you become.

SURVIVE

  • Manage a flashlight with finite battery life — explore, or stay in the dark.

  • Wield a firearm for self-defense and certain situations, but treat every bullet as precious. Sometimes the gun simply won't be there.

  • Restore health only through kits found in the world. Every encounter is potentially fatal.

GROW

  • Three Trees — Earn XP through field work and exploration, then invest across Physical Conditioning, Investigative Gear, and Environmental Traversal & Perception to master the mean streets of Gorenwille.

FEATURES

  • First-person psychological horror adventure

  • Single-player, story-driven experience

  • Non-linear story and levels

  • A gritty narrative inspired by real-life events

  • A story centered on mental health

  • Released episodically

Be ready… to lose… everything.

data.short_description: A first-person psychological horror adventure. Play detective Marshall Prime as ritualistic murders drag you back into the case that destroyed your life — and into a Cold War conspiracy buried beneath Gorenwille. Investigate. Survive. Lose everything.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Czech
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8.1, 10, 11 (32-bit or 64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Dual-Core min 2GHz (Core 2 Duo and above) or AMD Dual-Core min 2GHz (Phenom II X2 and above)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 450 series or AMD Radeon HD 5750 series or higher (minimum 1 GB dedicated VRAM GDDR5)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 22 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8.1, 10, 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Quad-Core (i5 2300) or AMD Octo-Core (FX 8150)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 660Ti or higher, AMD Radeon HD 7950 or higher (minimum 2 GB dedicated VRAM GDDR5)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 22 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes blood, gore, drugs, drug use, scary scenes, death.
